required_documents.name: SF-424 (R&R) Application for Federal Assistance
required_documents.details: Standard research cover form with applicant organizational details, cage code, and UEI.

required_documents.name: Technical Proposal & Statement of Work (SOW)
required_documents.details: Detailed technical narrative outlining scientific approach, military relevance, project milestones, and clear Statement of Work.

required_documents.name: Cost Proposal & Budget Narrative
required_documents.details: Complete itemized cost breakdown including direct labor rates, equipment, materials, subcontracts, and negotiated indirect cost rate agreement.

required_documents.name: Senior Personnel Biosketches and Current/Pending Support
required_documents.details: Biographical sketches for principal investigators and key contributors, along with complete federal funding disclosures.

required_documents.name: SAM.gov UEI and Grants.gov Workspace Registration
required_documents.details: Active SAM.gov registration with active UEI and submission via Grants.gov.

eligibility.summary: Accredited institutions of higher education, non-profit research organizations, and affiliated healthcare institutions. In North Carolina, universities, community colleges, and academic medical centers qualify.

cost_share.details: Cost sharing requirements not explicitly mandated in notice.

review_criteria.criterion: Relevance to Department of Defense and National Security Mission
Qualifications of Principal Investigator and Research Team

submission_limits: Only one application per institution is permitted; internal institutional screening required.
important_notes: Applications must be submitted electronically through the designated portal prior to the deadline: 2026-11-30.
SAM.gov registration must be active with valid Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) prior to submission; allow 3-4 weeks for new registrations.
Ensure all project narrative and attachment page limits are strictly respected to avoid administrative rejection without review.
